title: Recording, mixing: My Love by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Richard Lush

Wings completed work on ‘My Love’ on 27 January 1973.

The song had been recorded the previous day, with an orchestral arrangement by Richard Hewson.

On this day the band listened back to the recordings, and it was decided that additional backing vocals were needed. After they were completed, ‘My Love’ was mixed in stereo in five attempts, and the song was added to the tape reel of tracks ready for inclusion on Red Rose Speedway.

Page last updated: 27 November 2025
